description.value: Liquor Planet is a family-owned private liquor store in Langford, operating since 2013 and claiming the title of BC's biggest private bottle shop at 13,280 sq ft with 5,000+ products. The store is famous for its natural-history-museum theme: 60+ dinosaurs (several animatronic) prowl the aisles alongside a 10-foot custom saltwater aquarium and a giant dinosaur head built into the building's facade. A touring cyclist resupplying with beer, wine, or spirits will find one of the widest selections in the region, with DoorDash delivery also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Liquor Planet is an active, open business at 2317 Millstream Rd in Langford, BC. The website provides a phone number (250-391-9148) not in OSM, and clarifies the city is Langford — OSM tags the community as Victoria, which is a discrepancy worth flagging. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields default to null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Victoria' but the business is located in Langford, BC — a distinct municipality.
OSM has no phone number; website lists 250-391-9148 for the Millstream location.
Website lists a second location at 2792 Peatt Rd, Langford — OSM may benefit from a separate record for that branch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible liquor store with confirmed active website; a legitimate stop for touring cyclists resupplying in Langford.
